code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == grid[0][0]:
                continue
            for dr, dc in ((1, 1), (1, -1)):
                if (r-dr, c-dc) in seen:
                    continue
                # Start only at the beginning of this same-color diagonal run.
                if 0 <= r-dr < h and 0 <= c-dc < w and grid[r-dr][c-dc] == color:
                    continue
                run = []
                rr, cc = r, c
                while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and grid[rr][cc] == color:
                    run.append((rr, cc))
                    seen.add((rr, cc))
                    rr += dr
                    cc += dc
                if len(run) < (2 if color == 9 else 3):
                    continue
                # Extend each end through background cells until boundary or another object.
                for sr, sc in ( (r-dr, c-dc), (rr, cc) ):
                    # First endpoint walks backward; second starts after the run.
                    step_r, step_c = ((-dr, -dc) if (sr, sc) == (r-dr, c-dc) else (dr, dc))
                    while 0 <= sr < h and 0 <= sc < w and grid[sr][sc] == grid[0][0]:
                        out[sr][sc] = color
                        sr += step_r
                        sc += step_c
    return out
'''

    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

    for r in range(h):

            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == background:
                continue
            for dr, dc in ((1, 1), (1, -1)):
                pr, pc = r-dr, c-dc
                if 0 <= pr < h and 0 <= pc < w and grid[pr][pc] == color:
                    continue
                run = []
                rr, cc = r, c
                while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and grid[rr][cc] == color:
                    run.append((rr, cc))
                    rr += dr
                    cc += dc
                if len(run) < (2 if color == 9 else 3):
                    continue
                for sr, sc, step_r, step_c in ((r-dr, c-dc, -dr, -dc), (rr, cc, dr, dc)):
                    while 0 <= sr < h and 0 <= sc < w and grid[sr][sc] == background:

                        sc += step_c
